A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

The main takeaway from our work is that
students' experiences of transition are shaped by their emotional responses to university life, which in turn are shaped by the university's material environment and the students' social locations.
emotion is a key factor in the way in which students from different social class backgrounds position themselves with regard their transition to university.
the emotional dimension of students' experiences of transition needs to be taken more seriously by university educators, policy makers and students.
